dsh-visual-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

posts.en:
dsh-visual-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-363afc6170d7880291a4.html
